data.title: Kevin O’Leary eyes a $1 million Bitcoin — why the Shark Tank star says he’s placing his bets on a crypto comeback
data.description: A $1 million Bitcoin isn’t so far-fetched for one Shark Tank celeb. See why Kevin O’Leary is so sure that Bitcoin’s best days have yet to come.
data.keywords: Kevin O’Leary, Bitcoin, quantum computing, Shark Tank
